examples.title: Figure of eight
examples.description: Two sine waves, one twice as fast as the other, trace a sideways figure of eight one block pixel at a time, at the ZX81's 64 by 44 resolution.

examples.title: Square and cube
examples.description: Asks for a number and prints its square and its cube. ** is the ZX81's sign for a power.

examples.title: Letter dash
examples.description: A random letter appears: press that key as fast as you can. TIME counts how often the program looped while you looked for it.

manuals.title: Sinclair ZX81 BASIC Programming (1981)
manuals.note: Steven Vickers' manual that came with the ZX81, as a PDF scan; chapter 2 pictures the keyboard with every keyword

manuals.title: ZX81 BASIC Programming at the Internet Archive
manuals.note: The same manual, second edition, readable in the browser
